parts: On Wed, Mar 5, 2014 at 4:59 AM, J H <renalcl...@gmail.com> wrote:

> I want to plot a boxplot using ggplot, but have 3 variables I would like to
> be blotted for teh x-axis to show the appropriate boxes for each.
>
> I have 2 states: CA, NY
> I have 2 sales persons: Per 1 and Per 2
> I have 2 stores for each person
>
> How can I separate and show that in the x-axis? Thx

So you want the x axis to be the interaction between the three
variables right? You should be able to use

geom_boxplot(aes(x=state:
person:store, y=

or at least

geom_boxplot(aes(x=interaction(state, person, store), y=
